name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the complex systems behind Formula 1. He studied Computer Science at university, focusing on network architecture and data security. After graduating, he initially worked for a tech firm providing infrastructure solutions to various industries, but always kept an eye on opportunities in racing. He joined Carlin three years ago, bringing a fresh perspective on how IT can drive performance both on and off the track.

Alistair believes in a proactive approach to IT management, anticipating potential issues before they impact the team. He's constantly exploring new technologies and methodologies to improve data analysis, communication, and overall operational efficiency. What sets Alistair apart is his ability to translate complex technical jargon into easily understandable concepts, fostering collaboration between technical and non-technical staff.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side parting
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a lean build, often seen sporting a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with tech ideas.
Has a collection of vintage circuit posters in his office.
Prefers to take the stairs instead of the elevator, claiming it helps him think clearly.
